## TabStation 2.18.10

- Fixed: choosing "HyperOS wallpaper" in "Change wallpaper" didn't change the desktop. The previous picture stayed behind it. The desktop now shows your HyperOS wallpaper right away, in both macOS and Windows mode.
- Removed "System wallpaper (HyperOS)…" from the desktop menu. It did nothing on HyperOS, and it was only about the HyperOS wallpaper, not TabStation. Use "Same as HyperOS" in "Change wallpaper…" to show your HyperOS wallpaper on the TabStation desktop.
- In "Change wallpaper", "HyperOS wallpaper" is now called "Same as HyperOS", because the TabStation desktop just shows your current HyperOS wallpaper and doesn't change it.
- Smoother macOS ↔ Windows switching: after you confirm, the "Switching appearance…" screen stays until the new desktop and wallpaper are ready, then takes you straight to the desktop in the new mode. No more brief freeze, and no need to tap "Back to Desktop".
- Fixed: when Settings was open as a floating window (from the taskbar), "Back to Desktop" or switching mode could freeze, flash the HyperOS home screen or play two transitions. Settings now just closes and you're back on the desktop.
- Fixed: a picture chosen with "Upload picture…" could end up as "My picture" for the other mode if the mode changed while the picker was open. It now always goes to the mode you were in when you opened the picker.
- All six built-in wallpapers are now realistic 4K landscapes rendered for TabStation:
  - macOS: **Dusk** (mountains at sunset), **Mist** (misty lake at dawn), **Ocean** (open sea with sun glitter)
  - Windows: **Lake** (alpine lake with mirror reflections, was Bloom), **Aurora** (northern lights over snowy mountains), **Dunes** (desert dunes, was Prism)
- From 2.18.9: built-in 4K wallpapers (macOS: Dusk, Mist, Ocean · Windows: Bloom, Aurora, Prism) and a "Change wallpaper…" gallery from the desktop menu and Settings.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.

## TabStation 2.18.9

- **Built-in 4K wallpapers:** three original wallpapers for each mode, rendered at 3840×2560 and drawn for TabStation (free to use, not taken from Apple or Microsoft).
  - macOS: **Dusk**, **Mist**, **Ocean**
  - Windows: **Bloom**, **Aurora**, **Prism**
- **Change wallpaper:** right-click or long-press the desktop → "Change wallpaper…" opens a gallery with previews: the presets, "My picture", "Upload picture…" and the HyperOS wallpaper. The same gallery is in Settings → Appearance → Wallpaper. Each mode keeps its own choice.
- Your own picture is kept when you pick a preset or the HyperOS wallpaper, so you can switch back any time. "Use system wallpaper" no longer deletes it.
- New installs start with a preset. If you update and never set a TabStation wallpaper, you keep the HyperOS wallpaper as before.
- Windows mode: tapping a window's "•••" handle no longer leaves TabStation's window buttons on top of the HyperOS window menu.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.

## TabStation 2.18.8

- **No more flash when opening apps:** opening an app that isn't running yet shows a short loading screen over your desktop wallpaper. Before, HyperOS briefly showed its own wallpaper or a black screen. Settings → Dock & windows → "Loading screen when opening apps" (needs Shizuku).
- **Full taskbar and Dock:** when there are more apps than fit, the extra ones go into a "…" button at the end, like Windows 11. Before, icons overlapped the clock and status area or ran off the screen. The app you're using and your open apps stay visible first, then pinned apps. Open apps are ticked in the "…" list.
- **Smoother macOS ↔ Windows switching:** while TabStation is on, picking the other mode asks first, then shows a "Switching appearance…" screen while the Dock, menu bar and wallpaper reload, with no flicker.
- Fixed: "Turn on TabStation" in a Settings window opened from the taskbar could end on the HyperOS home screen.
- Fixed: with the desktop in a top/bottom split (portrait), TabStation could take it out of the split.
- Fixed: window buttons could stay hidden for up to 30 seconds if a finger was still down when the touch reader stopped. The reader now also stops when window buttons are turned off.
- Fixed: very long bug reports could fail to open in the email app.
- Smaller fixes: less memory used by the Home screen while it's in the background, and no grey flash when the custom wallpaper is turned off.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
